state = bot.status()
geometry = state['tool_geometry_reference']
top = np.array(surfaces['purple_top']['center_m'])
destination = np.array(surfaces['orange_top']['center_m'])
pad_mid = np.array(state['nominal_pad_pose']['arms']['left']['pad_midpoint_tool_m'])
opening = np.array(state['opening_axes_base']['left'])
opening[2] = 0
opening /= np.linalg.norm(opening)
forward = np.array([opening[1], -opening[0], 0])
support_upper = max(surfaces[k]['upper_m'][2] for k in ['table_broad', 'table_near', 'table_clear'])
grasp_options = []
for degrees in [0, 10, 15, 20, 25, 35]:
    angle = np.deg2rad(degrees)
    approach = np.sin(angle)*forward + np.array([0, 0, -np.cos(angle)])
    rotation = np.column_stack((np.cross(opening, approach), opening, approach))
    grasp = top - rotation @ (pad_mid + np.array([0, 0, .003]))
    lowest_tip = grasp[2] - .013*abs(rotation[2, 0]) - geometry['max_tip_z_m']*abs(rotation[2, 2])
    budget = lowest_tip - support_upper - .003 - .003
    placement = grasp + np.array([
        destination[0]-top[0], destination[1]-top[1],
        destination[2]-surfaces['table_broad']['center_m'][2]
    ])
    checks = {}
    for label, point in [('grasp', grasp), ('placement', placement),
                         ('approach', grasp-approach*.06)]:
        checks[label] = bot.plan_move(
            left_x=float(point[0]), left_y=float(point[1]), left_z=float(point[2]),
            rotation={'left': rotation}
        )
    grasp_options.append((degrees, rotation, grasp, placement, budget, checks))
    print(degrees, 'conservative_tip_clearance_m', budget, 'plans', checks)
